ui.title: LLM ControlCenter
ui.token_hint: The value shown once at issue time. Cleared when you close the tab.
ui.locale_pack_warning: PII from packs that are not enabled will not be caught.
ui.single_homed_help: This role's model lives on one node only. If that node saturates, only this role starves.
ui.review_help: Someone must judge audit-grade hits before the promotion gate opens.
ui.raw_audited: Reading the raw prompt is recorded in the audit log.
ui.retention_capped: Capped to {days} days by the platform maximum.
ui.raw_storage_off: No master key, so raw prompts are not retained.
ui.purge_warning: This cannot be undone. Type the confirmation value exactly.
ui.token_shown_once: This value is shown only now. Save it.
ui.retarget_hint: Target node — can be changed until approved
ui.airgap_on: Air-gapped mode — cloud tiers are disabled.
ui.classifier_off: The stage-two classifier is not wired, so context rules are not evaluated.
ui.grace_mode: Guard grace mode — blocking rules are downgraded to masking (full) and do not stop requests.
ui.plugin_token_once: This token is shown once. Put it in the plugin's configuration
ui.plugin_installed_inactive: Installed. Turning it on is a separate decision
ui.plugin_no_trust_key: No trust keys — signed bundles cannot be installed
ui.login_hint: Sign in with an admin account. The session expires after 12 hours.
ui.password_changed: Password changed. Sessions on other devices were signed out.
ui.account_reset_done: Reset. That account's sessions were signed out.
ui.platform_blocked: Platform administration is not reachable at this address. The public entry point blocks /v1/platform/* — use the on-site address or a VPN.
ui.desc_overview: Nodes, lanes, queue and approvals on one screen. Refreshes every 15 seconds.
ui.desc_nodes: Backends that run models. A job goes to a node that has the model and has room.
ui.desc_tenants: The isolation unit. Tokens, services, data and budget belong to it.
ui.desc_models: Installed models per node, the catalog, and install requests.
ui.desc_rules: Baseline is the platform default; guard is this tenant's effective rules.
ui.desc_jobs: Masked copies only. Raw reads are one at a time and audited.
ui.desc_usage: Calls, tokens, cost, latency and success rate along the axis you pick.
ui.desc_alerts: Sent on state transitions only. No secrets, no prompts.
ui.pending_help: A tenant asked for a model no node has. Approving makes that node pull it right away.
ui.no_waiting: No jobs are waiting — every lane is idle.
ui.lane_note: Concurrency is the node pool total
ui.waiting_note: Why the queue is stopped right now
ui.grace_help: Grace mode downgrades blocking rules to masking (full). Use it only during rollout and false-positive review.
ui.name: Name
